honest_summary: The official proof (Finset/Dedup.lean:117) uses ONLY pre-existing Mathlib lemmas (toFinset_zero, singleton_ne_empty, mem_toFinset, mem_singleton, toFinset_nsmul, toFinset_singleton). Therefore there is NO genuinely missing lemma — candidate lemmas 1-4 are duplicates/corollaries of existing results. The only non-duplicate, promising item is a TACTIC FAMILY (candidate 5), tested live in Part 3, not a new lemma.
